card.title: Fluent in Feelings
card.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

transfer.opening: Your polite answer sounds like resentment. {request}
transfer.response: You're feeling unheard. Tell me what you need before we go on. {counter}
transfer.challenge: Can't you take my words literally?
transfer.closing: That request for literalness is a boundary. Say it again so I can acknowledge it properly.

originalTransfer.action: I label the pause beside {prop} on my notepad.
originalTransfer.opening: That sounds like frustration wearing a polite coat. {request}
originalTransfer.response: I'm translating the feeling, not criticizing it. {counter}
originalTransfer.challenge: Can't you take my words literally?
originalTransfer.closing: Then explain why your shoulders keep supplying a different sentence.

card.title: Fluent in Feelings
card.instruction: Treat every reaction as evidence you can expertly interpret; translate feelings, correct emotional misunderstandings, and prescribe the proper response.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: You're laughing too quickly at that joke. Avoidance?

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Humour is often the front door to discomfort.

originalDialogue.speaker: A
originalDialogue.text: Seeking comfort. Which feeling would you like with them?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're laughing very quickly at Dad's impression. Nervous about meeting my parents?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's approval-seeking. You can let a joke pass without earning your place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you pass the biscuits? I missed lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Comfort-seeking now. Say 'I belong here' before you take one. Let's feed the insecurity first.

bindings.scope: Fresh binding-only review of an explicit transfer-body amendment. Read the exact card, both original and accepted candidate single dialogues, and every original/proposed transfer field. Are the proposed fields faithful to the exact mechanism and their described source material? Identify real residual contradictions or unsupported details. Seed hashes still describe the historical originals; validated integration will bind the accepted dialogue only after your compatibility assessment. A compiled transfer is not an individually reviewed pair. Do not score single or pair dialogue; records must be empty. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
